description: Source code for pytest-based tests for the Angular template initialization and project setup logic within the universalinit project.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Configuration data class for project details such as name, version, description, author, type, output path, and parameters.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enumeration of supported project types, e.g., ANGULAR.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Data class encapsulating initialization commands and environment setup for templates.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main class responsible for initializing projects based on templates, reading configurations, and executing setup routines.

classes.name: TemplateProvider
classes.description: Provides template instances based on directory paths or project type.

classes.name: AngularTemplate
classes.description: Template class for Angular projects, implementing methods for getting init info, processing templates, and initializing projects.

methods.name: test_angular_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Test that the Angular template's initialization info can be correctly retrieved, including environment commands.

methods.name: test_project_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Test the actual initialization process of an Angular project, verifying directory structure and content replacement.

methods.name: test_post_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Test the execution of post-processing scripts, including detection of successful script execution via marker files.

methods.name: test_config_file_loading(temp_dir)
methods.description: Test loading project configurations from a JSON file.

methods.name: test_template_variable_replacement(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Verify that template placeholders in files are replaced correctly with project metadata.
